device_entry.name: 相机抽象控制组件
tags: 显微成像与光学显微实验
device_entry.description: 这是一个非物理的相机软件组件，用于显微实验采集中统一表示相机对象，并为相机映射、多视图成像等功能提供通用接口。现有证据更支持其为相机控制的抽象基类或辅助模块，而不是某一台具体相机硬件。
device_entry.description_en: This is a non-physical camera software component that provides a common abstraction for camera objects in microscopy acquisition and supports features such as camera mapping and multiview imaging. The evidence supports it being an abstract base/helper module for camera control rather than a specific camera instrument.
